stem:
Kiara holds a thick book between a desk lamp and a notebook page. Light from the lamp is blocked by the book before it reaches the page.

Answer both parts.

parts.text: Which change makes the shadow on the page smaller?

options.text: Moving the book closer to the page.
Moving the book closer to the lamp.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

part_answers.answer: Moving the opaque book closer to the screen shrinks the shadow; moving it toward the lamp enlarges the shadow, and switching the lamp off removes the shadow.

teacher.key_rationale: Shadow size depends on object position relative to lamp and screen: closer to screen → smaller shadow. Closer to lamp enlarges it; lamp off ends the shadow.
